blocks.text: SINGAPORE — Inquirer Group of Companies chair Ms Sandy Prieto-Romualdez, who is also Asia-Pacific chair of the World Association of News Publishers (WAN-IFRA), formally opened the 6th Asian Media Leaders Summit (AMLS) here yesterday with a call to collaborate and innovate to meet the unprecedented challenges facing the news media industry. More than 200 media leaders and professionals representing 94 organizations from 35 countries gathered for AMLS 2026 to discuss industry strategies, global best practices, and cutting-edge solutions to address technological disruptions and a fragmented media landscape.
